from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/269-44/1_269-44_input.xlsx')
output_path = Path('/mnt/data/outputs/269-44_0_535d0a95/1_269-44_output.xlsx')

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Import Data'] if 'Import Data' in wb.sheetnames else wb.active

# Determine the extent of the data in column A from the workbook at run time.
# Use ws.max_row so blank rows within the used area (which may be among the four rows to delete)
# are retained/shifted correctly unless they are explicitly deleted.
max_row = ws.max_row

# Read column A values as they currently stand.
original_values = [ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value for r in range(1, max_row + 1)]

# Mark the four rows immediately preceding every "Chassis" in column A for deletion.
rows_to_delete = set()
for idx, val in enumerate(original_values, start=1):
    if isinstance(val, str) and val.strip() == "Chassis":
        for r in range(max(1, idx - 4), idx):
            rows_to_delete.add(r)

# Build the resulting column A after those row deletions.
result_values = [
    val for idx, val in enumerate(original_values, start=1)
    if idx not in rows_to_delete
]

# Only modify the permitted answer range A1:A15.
for r in range(1, 16):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value = result_values[r - 1] if r <= len(result_values) else None

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: reopen and print A1:A15 from the saved workbook.
check_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
check_ws = check_wb[ws.title]
print("Sheet:", check_ws.title)
print("A1:A15 after processing:")
for r in range(1, 16):
    print(f"A{r} = {check_ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value!r}")
